AreaPrecision.description:
How coarse the stored area of a profile is; the owner chooses it.

Each value names a grid. The grids are nested: a cell of a coarser grid consists of whole
cells of every finer one, so an area can be made coarser later without knowing the point it
came from. ``PLACE`` is the choice of a city or a district alone.
AreaPrecision.title: AreaPrecision

CapabilityItem.description: A declared capability; used in requests and in the owner's response.
CapabilityItem.title: CapabilityItem

CategoryCode.description: Code of a capability category (what a person can do, not a condition).
CategoryCode.title: CategoryCode

ContactRequiredResponse.description: Body of the 409 that asks the caller to add a contact to the profile first.
ContactRequiredResponse.title: ContactRequiredResponse

Direction.description: Which side of the invitations of a user to list.
Direction.title: Direction

DistanceBand.description:
Distance shown to the caller instead of the exact value.

The value is the display label of the reference implementation, kept so the wire format
does not change.
DistanceBand.title: DistanceBand

DistrictCode.description: Code of an administrative district; the prefix keeps codes unique across cities.
DistrictCode.title: DistrictCode

EmailNotVerifiedResponse.description: Body of the 403 that asks the caller to confirm the e-mail address first.
EmailNotVerifiedResponse.title: EmailNotVerifiedResponse

EquipmentCode.description: Code of a piece of equipment a person uses.
EquipmentCode.title: EquipmentCode

EquipmentRule.description: An equipment code and the categories it may be attached to.
EquipmentRule.title: EquipmentRule

ErrorResponse.description: Body of every domain error: a fixed message that never repeats the input.
ErrorResponse.title: ErrorResponse

ForgotPasswordRequest.description: Body of ``POST /auth/forgot-password``: the address a reset link is asked for.
ForgotPasswordRequest.title: ForgotPasswordRequest

FunctionalLevel.description: Coarse functional compatibility; the only form of it that may be shown or learned.
FunctionalLevel.title: FunctionalLevel

InvitationIncoming.description: An invitation as its recipient sees it; the other party is the sender.
InvitationIncoming.title: InvitationIncoming

InvitationOutgoing.description: An invitation as its sender sees it; the other party is the recipient.
InvitationOutgoing.title: InvitationOutgoing

InvitationPartner.description: The other party of an invitation: public profile fields and, once accepted, a contact.

has_photo.description: Whether GET /profiles/{id}/photo has a picture for the caller.
has_photo.title: Has Photo

InvitationPartner.title: InvitationPartner

LoginRequest.description:
Body of ``POST /auth/login``.

The password length is only capped, never checked against the registration policy, so a
short wrong password gets the same answer as any other wrong password.
LoginRequest.title: LoginRequest

MatchBreakdown.description:
Points of each criterion of the baseline formula, with 0.1 resolution.

``functional`` is a level, not points. ``total`` is the baseline score from 0 to 100; it is
shown even when a learned ranker ordered the feed, so it need not decrease down the list.
MatchBreakdown.title: MatchBreakdown

MatchFeed.description:
One page of the caller's feed.

``total`` is the length of the whole ranked feed (at most the configured maximum), so a
client can tell whether another page exists. ``max_points`` are the denominators of the
points in every item's breakdown.
MatchFeed.title: MatchFeed

MatchItem.description: A candidate in the feed: public fields plus the reasons for the position.

has_photo.description: Whether GET /profiles/{id}/photo has a picture for the caller.
has_photo.title: Has Photo

MatchItem.title: MatchItem

MatchMaxPoints.description:
Highest points of the criteria whose points are shown, from the default baseline weights.

There is deliberately no entry for the functional criterion: it is reported as a level only,
and a number next to it would invite reading its points back out of the total.
MatchMaxPoints.title: MatchMaxPoints

MatchRankInfluence.description: How each criterion moved a candidate in a learned ranking, compared with the others.
MatchRankInfluence.title: MatchRankInfluence

NewsColumnOut.description: The newest items of one category.
NewsColumnOut.title: NewsColumnOut

NewsItemOut.description: One item of the digest: what the page needs to link to the original article.
NewsItemOut.title: NewsItemOut

NewsResponse.description: The digest for the landing page, one column per category.
NewsResponse.title: NewsResponse

PhotoRejectedResponse.description: Body of the 422 answer to an upload that cannot be used as a photograph.
PhotoRejectedResponse.title: PhotoRejectedResponse

ProfileOwner.description:
What the owner sees: the public fields plus the private ones, still no location.

``area_precision`` says how coarse the stored area is; the area itself is not returned.

has_photo.description: Whether GET /profiles/{id}/photo has a picture for the caller.
has_photo.title: Has Photo

ProfileOwner.title: ProfileOwner

ProfilePublic.description: What another signed-in user sees: no capabilities, no contact, no location.

has_photo.description: Whether GET /profiles/{id}/photo has a picture for the caller.
has_photo.title: Has Photo

ProfilePublic.title: ProfilePublic

ProfilePut.description:
Body of ``PUT /profiles/me``: the full profile, replacing the previous one.

``latitude`` and ``longitude`` go together: send both or neither. Both omitted (or null)
keeps the location stored with the existing profile, so the contact or the sports can be
edited without entering the location again. The first save of a profile needs both, and
sending only one is rejected.

area_precision.description: How coarse the stored area is: a grid of about 1, 2 or 4 km, or 'place' for a city or district alone. With coordinates it selects the grid they are coarsened to; without them a coarser value coarsens the stored area and a finer one is ignored. Omit to keep the stored choice (4km for a new profile).

latitude.description: Exact latitude, -90 to 90; coarsened to a grid cell before storage and never returned. Send together with longitude, or omit both to keep the stored location (required on the first save).
latitude.title: Latitude

longitude.description: Exact longitude, -180 to 180; coarsened to a grid cell before storage and never returned. Send together with latitude, or omit both to keep the stored location (required on the first save).
longitude.title: Longitude

ProfilePut.title: ProfilePut

RankInfluence.description:
Qualitative effect of one criterion on the position of a candidate in a learned ranking.

Shown instead of a raw model score, which is not calibrated and must not be read as a
percentage.
RankInfluence.title: RankInfluence

RankSource.description: Which strategy produced the order of a feed; shown to the caller.
RankSource.title: RankSource

ResetPasswordRequest.description: Body of ``POST /auth/reset-password``: the token from the link and the new password.
ResetPasswordRequest.title: ResetPasswordRequest

SearchRadius.description: Search radius a caller may ask for: one of the distance bands of the API, in kilometres.
SearchRadius.title: SearchRadius

SkillLevel.description: Self-declared skill in one sport, ordered from beginner to advanced.
SkillLevel.title: SkillLevel

SportItem.description: A sport with the self-declared skill; used in requests and responses.
SportItem.title: SportItem

TaxonomyResponse.description: Versioned code lists used by profile input. Reference data, not personal data.
TaxonomyResponse.title: TaxonomyResponse

UserResponse.description: The caller's own account; the e-mail is shown to its owner only.
UserResponse.title: UserResponse

VerifyEmailRequest.description: Body of ``POST /auth/verify-email``: the token from the link in the message.
VerifyEmailRequest.title: VerifyEmailRequest

post.description:
Ask for a password-reset link to be sent to an address.

The answer is always 204: an unknown address, a known one and one that was sent a link a
moment ago cannot be told apart, and the message goes out after the response.

:param body: The address.
:param service: Authentication service.
:return: An empty response.

Exchange credentials for an access token.

:param body: E-mail and password.
:param service: Authentication service.
:raises AuthenticationError: If the credentials are wrong (answered with 401).
:return: A bearer token.

delete.description:
Delete the caller's account together with the profile and all data under it.

:param current: The authenticated caller.
:param service: Authentication service.
:return: An empty response.

get.description:
Return the caller's account.

:param current: The authenticated caller.
:return: The account.

post.description:
Create an account.

:param body: E-mail and password.
:param service: Authentication service.
:raises ConflictError: If the e-mail is already registered (answered with 409).
:return: The new account.

Send the confirmation message again.

The answer is always 204, whether or not a message was sent: an account that is already
confirmed, or was sent one a moment ago, gets nothing and learns nothing.

:param current: The authenticated caller.
:param service: Authentication service.
:return: An empty response.

Set a new password with the token from the message.

No sign-in is needed: the person forgot the password. Tokens issued before the change stop
working.

:param body: The token and the new password.
:param service: Authentication service.
:raises InvalidResetError: If the token is unknown, used or expired (answered 400).
:return: An empty response.

Confirm the e-mail address with the token from the message.

No sign-in is needed: the link is opened from a mailbox, possibly on another device.

:param body: The token.
:param service: Authentication service.
:raises InvalidVerificationError: If the token is unknown, used or expired (answered 400).
:return: An empty response.

get.description:
List the caller's invitations, newest first.

:param current: The authenticated caller.
:param service: Invitation service.
:param direction: Only ``incoming`` or only ``outgoing``; both when omitted.
:param status_filter: Keep one status; a stale pending invitation counts as expired.
:param skip: Number of invitations to skip.
:param limit: Maximum number of invitations to return.
:return: The caller's invitations.

schema.title: Response Get Invitations Api V1 Invitations Get

post.description:
Invite the owner of a visible profile to train together.

A hidden profile is answered exactly like a missing one (404).

:param body: The profile to invite.
:param current: The authenticated caller; needs a profile of their own.
:param service: Invitation service.
:raises NotFoundError: If the profile is missing or hidden (answered with 404).
:raises ConflictError: If the caller has no profile, targets themselves or already has a
    pending invitation to this person (answered with 409).
:raises ContactRequiredError: If the caller's profile has no contact (409, code
    ``contact_required``).
:return: The new invitation as the sender sees it.

schema.title: Response Post Invitation Api V1 Invitations Post
Response 403 Post Invitation Api V1 Invitations Post

get.description:
Return one invitation the caller sent or received.

:param invitation_id: Identifier of the invitation.
:param current: The authenticated caller.
:param service: Invitation service.
:raises NotFoundError: If it does not exist or the caller is not a participant (404).
:return: The invitation as the caller sees it.

schema.title: Response Get Invitation Api V1 Invitations  Invitation Id  Get

post.description:
Accept an invitation addressed to the caller; both contacts are released.

:param invitation_id: Identifier of the invitation.
:param current: The authenticated caller, who must be the recipient.
:param service: Invitation service.
:raises NotFoundError: If the caller is not a participant (404).
:raises AccessDeniedError: If the caller is the sender (403).
:raises ConflictError: If the invitation is expired or no longer pending (409).
:raises ContactRequiredError: If the caller's profile has no contact (409, code
    ``contact_required``).

:param current: The authenticated caller, who must be the sender.

:raises AccessDeniedError: If the caller is the recipient (403).

get.description:
Return a page of potential training partners for the caller, best first.

The feed is always built for the caller's own profile. Each entry shows the public profile
fields, the distance as a band, the points of the baseline formula by criterion and the
functional criterion as a level only. When a learned ranker orders the feed, ``rank_source``
says so and ``rank_influence`` tells, per criterion, whether it raised or lowered the
position; the raw model score is never returned.

:param current: The authenticated caller.
:param service: Matching service.
:param skip: Number of entries to skip.
:param limit: Page size, at most 50.
:param radius_km: Optional narrower search radius, one of 5, 10 or 25.
:param sport: Optional sport filter.
:raises NotFoundError: If the caller has no profile yet (answered with 404).
:return: The page with the total length of the feed.

parameters.description: Narrow the search to one distance band; default is the full radius
parameters.name: radius_km

schema.description: Narrow the search to one distance band; default is the full radius
schema.title: Radius Km

parameters.description: Only candidates who practise this sport
parameters.name: sport

get.description:
Return the newest collected items of each category.

No sign-in is needed: the items are links to public articles of public sources, and the
landing page shows them to every visitor. They are collected once a day by a separate
worker, never while a visitor waits.

:param service: News service.
:param limit: Maximum number of items per category.
:return: One column per category.

delete.description:
Delete the caller's profile; the account stays.

:param current: The authenticated caller.
:param service: Profile service.
:raises NotFoundError: If the caller has no profile (answered with 404).
:return: An empty response.

get.description:
Return the caller's own profile.

:param current: The authenticated caller.
:param service: Profile service.
:raises NotFoundError: If the caller has no profile yet (answered with 404).
:return: The profile as its owner sees it.

put.description:
Create or fully replace the caller's profile.

The exact location is coarsened to a grid cell before it is stored and is never returned.
Latitude and longitude are optional on an update: omit both to keep the stored cell. The
first save needs both. Capabilities are stored only while ``functional_data_consent`` is
true.

:param body: The complete profile; the location is both coordinates or neither.
:param current: The authenticated caller.
:param service: Profile service.
:raises LocationRequiredError: If there is no profile yet and the body has no location
    (answered with 422).
:return: The stored profile as its owner sees it.

delete.description:
Delete the caller's photograph; the answer is the same when there was none.

:param current: The authenticated caller.
:param service: Profile service.
:raises NotFoundError: If the caller has no profile (answered with 404).
:return: An empty response.

put.description:
Upload the caller's photograph, replacing the previous one.

The body is the picture itself (JPEG, PNG or WebP, at most 2 MB), not a form. It is decoded
and stored again as a small square JPEG, so the original file and its metadata are not kept.

:param request: The upload; its body is the picture.
:param current: The authenticated caller.
:param service: Profile service.
:raises PhotoRejectedError: If the body is too large or is not a picture (answered with 422).
:raises NotFoundError: If the caller has no profile yet (answered with 404).
:return: An empty response.

get.description:
Return the public view of a visible profile.

The same answer, 404, is given for a missing profile and for a hidden one.

:param profile_id: Identifier of the profile.
:param current: The authenticated caller; any signed-in user may look.
:param service: Profile service.
:raises NotFoundError: If the profile is missing or hidden (answered with 404).
:return: Display name, district, intensity and sports.

Return the photograph of a profile as a JPEG.

The owner always gets their own. Anyone else gets it only while the profile is visible; a
hidden profile, a missing profile and a profile without a photograph all answer 404.

:param profile_id: Identifier of the profile.
:param current: The authenticated caller.
:param service: Profile service.
:raises NotFoundError: If there is nothing the caller may see (answered with 404).
:return: The picture, cacheable only by the caller's own browser.

Return the versioned code lists; public, since they hold no personal data.

:return: Sports, capability categories, equipment rules, districts and ranges, as codes.

Report that the process is alive; does not touch the database.

:return: Static ``ok`` status.

Report that the database answers.

:param service: Readiness service.
:raises HTTPException: 503 when the database is unreachable. This module is the API layer,
